scope: Proposition 10.1 (Bounded exponents for the inverse-density budget) of the manuscript “Signed tensor densities and diagram budgets for the Thorp shuffle” (preprints/Signed-tensor-densities-and-diagram-budgets-for-coordinate-sweeps-September-26-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 238 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 69f29b044ee825ef), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 72. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There are real exponents pd ≥ 2, with supd≥1 pd < ∞, such that for every d ≥ 1 and every λ ⊢ n = 2d, log Jn(λ, pd) ≤ ( Gn(λ), n − λ1 > n1−ϵ, 0, n − λ1 ≤ n1−ϵ. For all sufficiently large n, the second bound strengthens to log Jn(λ, pd) ≤ −10k log n when 1 ≤ k = n − λ1 ≤ n1−ϵ.
